instruction: Candid celebratory medium shot photograph of a cozy indoor room with wooden paneling and a round mirror. In the center, the grey-haired woman in the light grey dress (R1) laughs joyfully as she is embraced from the right by the short-haired woman in the white blouse (R2), who leans in with a warm smile. On the left, the blonde woman in the orange patterned dress (R3) stands facing right, smiling happily while gently holding the grey-haired woman's (R1) arm. In the foreground, a festive table is decorated with a birthday cake, cupcakes, and champagne glasses. The scene is illuminated by warm, soft indoor lighting, creating a golden, joyful atmosphere.
